training: Empirical-model offline Bellman RL, same declared physical queue and cost. Five port-year block bootstrap fits for chosen candidate, not five independent field trials or neural gradient seeds. Normal/delay residuals deduplicated; synthetic surge only included in explicitly named contamination ablation.
baselines: Same information and safety filter: PID, deterministic MPC28/90 risk0/.5, mean-corrected MPC28/90 using same learned conditional error mean, stochasticMPC28 using same learned distribution/solver. Exact deterministic envelope is independently checked against original V3cost interpolation, not a weakened baseline.
selection: Development2025safety-first: minimize feasible-window violations, then excess over max-capacity, then maximize normal score. Guarded and raw selections separate; raw-to-raw main test comparisons pre-registered. No test tuning.
admission_checks: positive eight-port-cluster95percent CI of normal relative cost gain
zero excess violations over maximum-capacity baseline
no port above50percent of positive gains
independence: 48seen ports development only, eight new IDs extracted after model/source freeze; fixed2026Jan/Apr90daywindows. Same pinned IMFexport, not newer vintage. All V6cohorts now viewed; comparisons on them are diagnostic only.
safety_limits_notice: Unannounced demand/outage under fixed proxy capacity can be intrinsically infeasible. Finite data zero extra violations is not a universal safety guarantee. No field authority.
metric: Original normalized queue/resource/switch/overflow/terminal proxy cost; neither money nor measured terminal productivity.
